about.title: About the Fusion Strike set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Fusion Strike is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 12 November 2021. It has 284 cards: 264 in the main set and 20 secret rares. There are also 217 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 264 main set cards), the Master set (481 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 501 cards, adding the 20 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
